TRANSITIONS & EFFECTS — the grammar argues, the effects are rendered, the budget escalates

no effect is added in post — everything visible in a product shot was rendered by the product · the edit only chooses where the knife falls — it selects, never fabricates · richness escalates deliberately — every escalation is a demo
